Name: Jether, Son of Gideon
Summary: Jether, Gideon's firstborn, was told to kill the captive kings Zebah and Zalmunna but drew not his sword, because he was yet a youth.
KeyStory: Gideon ordered Jether to slay the captive kings, but the youth feared, being yet a youth, so Gideon rose and slew them himself.
RelatedPeople: Gideon; Zebah, King of Midian; Zalmunna, King of Midian
LifeLesson: A father's hardest order fell on a son too young for it — and the father bore it himself.
